# DEPRECATIONS THAT ARE ALLOWED TO STAND, EACH WITH A REASON AND A DATE.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. 0.3.0's CI control greps the build log for
# "deprecated in macOS 27" only, because resolving the AVFoundation reader and
# writer deprecation was that release's whole job. It passed. Decision #504 then
# recorded "Zero deprecation diagnostics, and CI fails if one returns."
#
# MEASURED 2026-09-12 while building 0.4.0: that is not true of the build as a
# whole, and was not true of 0.3.0 either. v0.3.0's own green run (34701326745,
# Swift 6.3.3, SDK 26.5) emitted the Core Image Kernel Language deprecation
# below, 58 diagnostic lines of it, and passed — because the control was narrow
# and nothing looked wider. A narrow check that reads as a broad one is the
# defect class this repository is about: absence of a finding produced by
# absence of a search.
#
# So the control is now the inventory, not the keyword. CI extracts EVERY
# deprecation diagnostic in the build and compares it against this file:
#   * a diagnostic that is not listed here FAILS the build
#   * an entry listed here that no longer appears ALSO FAILS, because an
#     allowlist that keeps entries nothing emits any more rots exactly the way a
#     retired KB number cited as live authority rots
#
# FORMAT: one substring per line, matched against the normalized diagnostic text.
# Comments and blank lines ignored. Keep the reason directly above the entry.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Image Kernel Language. INHERITED FROM 0.1.0, NOT INTRODUCED IN 0.4.0.
#
# HLGGrade.kernel is the BT.2100 inverse OETF + OOTF + BT.2020-to-709 chain and
# DisplayImage.displayKernel is the Hable filmic curve. Both are rational
# functions of the input; neither is expressible with Core Image's built-in
# filters, so "use a built-in instead" is not available.
#
# The supported replacement is a Metal kernel — a .ci.metal source compiled with
# -fcikernel and linked with metallib -cikernel, loaded through
# CIColorKernel(functionName:fromMetalLibraryData:). SwiftPM has no native Metal
# compilation, so that means a build-tool plugin invoking xcrun, a metallib
# resource, and the Xcode app target resolving it through the package bundle.
# That is a real structural change to the build, and it was NOT attempted during
# 0.4.0, whose scope is the MCP front door (#507).
#
# It is recorded here rather than resolved, and the deadline is not open-ended:
# CIKL has been deprecated since macOS 10.14 and the AVFoundation precedent
# (#495, #504) is that Apple does eventually remove what it deprecates, at which
# point every measurement in this library stops compiling at once.
# Owner: Carver. Recorded 2026-09-12 against Walk 0.4.0.
'init(source:)' was deprecated in macOS 10.14: Core Image Kernel Language API deprecated.
